date_caption: Created May 4, 2026 for the 19th week of 2026.

news.title: Kentucky Derby 2026: Cherie DeVaux makes history as Golden Tempo wins after late surge - BBC

weekly_forecast: Golden Tempo's victory sparks a week of absurdity: Cherie DeVaux gets a surprise endorsement deal from a ramen brand, the losing jockey blames Mercury retrograde, and a conspiracy theory emerges that the horse was actually three Gemini twins in a trench coat. Meanwhile, Kentucky Derby officials panic as every Aries in the state demands a rematch.

signs.name: Aries
lines: You’re convinced you could’ve won the Derby if they’d just let you enter.
Impulsively bet your life savings on a horse named 'Mars Rising.' Spoiler: it came in last.

signs.name: Taurus
lines: You’re still savoring that mint julep from 2019. Slow and steady wins the race, right?
Refuse to acknowledge any horse but Golden Tempo exists now. Stubbornness is a virtue.

signs.name: Gemini
lines: You’ve already drafted 14 hot takes on the Derby. Half contradict each other.
Tried to place bets on two horses at once. The bookie is still confused.

signs.name: Cancer
lines: You cried during the Derby and you’re not sure why. Hormones? The horse’s eyes?
Secretly want to adopt Golden Tempo and knit him a tiny sweater.

signs.name: Leo
lines: You’re outraged the spotlight isn’t on YOU. Time to stage a dramatic solo victory lap.
Demand a crown for simply watching the race. It’s only fair.

signs.name: Virgo
lines: You’ve analyzed every frame of the race and found 37 flaws in the jockey’s form.
Secretly judge everyone who didn’t predict Golden Tempo’s win. The data was *obvious*.

signs.name: Libra
lines: Torn between cheering for the underdog and the favorite. You still haven’t picked a side.
Host a Derby-themed brunch to mediate between feuding horse fans. It’s chaos.

signs.name: Scorpio
lines: You know the *real* reason Golden Tempo won. (You don’t. But you’ll imply you do.)
Side-eye anyone who claims they ‘always believed’ in the horse. Liars.

signs.name: Sagittarius
lines: You bet on a horse named ‘Wanderlust’ because it ‘spoke to your soul.’ It came in ninth.
Already planning a trip to Kentucky to ‘find yourself’ in the winner’s circle.

signs.name: Capricorn
lines: You’ve turned Golden Tempo’s win into a 10-step career plan. Step 1: Buy a horse.
Judge the losing jockeys for ‘lack of preparation.’ Cold, but accurate.

signs.name: Aquarius
lines: You’re boycotting the Derby because ‘horse racing is a capitalist construct.’ (You still watched.)
Start a podcast about ‘equine liberation.’ It has three listeners, all Pisces.

signs.name: Pisces
lines: You’re pretty sure Golden Tempo winked at you. This is your soulmate now.
Cried during the race, then forgot why. Was it the horses or the existential dread?
